description: This file is a JavaScript source script for a Node.js environment, performing setup, plugin management, and testing for the 'build-smoke-plugin' in an openclaw project. It imports modules, sets up warning filters, manages temporary directories, loads plugins, and runs assertions to verify plugin loading and command registration.

methods.name: installProcessWarningFilter
methods.description: Sets up a global warning filter to suppress specific deprecation warnings related to punycode in the process environment.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes plugin commands and deletes temporary directories at process exit or interruption.
